question: The target for the first commitment period of the Kyoto Protocol is to reduce emissions of how many greenhouse gases by 5.2% from 1990 levels?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kyoto Protocol:-**

 
 
• The target for the first commitment period of the Kyoto Protocol is to reduce emissions of 6 greenhouse gases by 5.2% from 1990 levels.
 
• This reduction applies to carbon dioxide (CO2), methane (CH4), nitrous oxide (N2O), hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs), perfluorocarbons (PFCs), and sulphur hexafluoride (SF6).
